articles.title: Letter: the Foundry Row Mutual Aid Group Did a Good Job This Winter
body: To the editor: Please keep the tool library in the budget. Many of us on Oak Street use it every week.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Agnes Cifuentes, Cedar Hollow

articles.title: Zoning Board Hears Plan for Playground Upgrade Near Cedar Hollow
articles.deck: Supporters and opponents on Fairview Road disagreed about cost and timing.
body: Staff recommended approval with two conditions: a traffic study and a public notice period of 30 days. The ordinance will return to the agenda at the next regular session, unless the chair calls a special meeting first.
Councilmember Sadie Gruber asked for more time to review the proposal, which would cost about $850.
Public works estimates the work will take about 28 weeks once it starts in November.
